comments.author: @tysoncung
comments.text: Been following this closely. What do you make of it?

comments.author: @tysoncung
comments.text: Anyone try on Mac Studio 512GB RAM? Please let me know.

replies.author: @tysoncung
replies.text:
Short answer: no, and it is not close. K3 is 2.81T parameters, MoE with 16 of 896 experts active. Even at 4-bit that is roughly 1.4TB of weights, and every expert has to sit in memory whether it fires or not. A 512GB Studio gets you about a third of the way.

Worth knowing: the only tag on Ollama right now is kimi-k3:cloud, so pulling it does not run it on your machine at all, it routes to Moonshot's servers. Local K3 is not a thing on any Mac yet.
